learning_outcomes.text: Determine relevant information to describe a system.
Calculate the characteristic parameters of a two-phase flow.
Calculate the power and efficiency of different thermodynamic cycles.
Calculate heat transfer with conduction and convection.

syllabus_topics: Principles of thermodynamics - open/closed systems - real fluids and ideal gas
Phase transition: mixture properties - thermodynamic diagrams and tables
Thermodynamic cycles and heat engines - engine cycles: Carnot, Rankine, reheat cycle, Joule, Otto and Diesel cycles
Inverse vapor compression cycles: Carnot and Joule cycles - heat pump - refrigeration and air conditioning - moist air - vapor absorption cycles
Non-equilibrium thermodynamics - heat transfer (conduction and convection)
bibliography: Thermodynamique et énergétique par M. BOREL (Presses polytechniques Romandes)
Thermodynamique générale et application par R. KLING (Technip)
Introduction aux problèmes énergétiques globaux par R. GICQUEL (Presses des Mines)
Fundamentals of thermodynamics by Sonntag, Borgnakke & Van Wylen (Wiley ed.)
degree: Diplôme d'ingénieur Centrale Nantes, spécialité Mécanique (apprentissage)
